Tohoku Univ. University House/International House 
Application Guide October, 2026 
 
 
  We are now accepting new residence applications from international students for Tohoku 
University's University House and International House dormitories.  
 
 
●Accommodations and Locations 
・University House Aobayama  468-1 Aramaki-Aza Aoba Aobaku Sendai 980-0845 
・University House Sanjo   19-1 Sanjomachi Aobaku Sendai 981-0935 
・University House Sanjo Ⅱ  19-1 Sanjomachi Aobaku Sendai 981-0935 
・University House Sanjo Ⅲ  19-1 Sanjomachi Aobaku Sendai 981-0935 
・International House Sanjo 1  19-1 Sanjomachi Aobaku Sendai 981-0935 
・International House Sanjo 2  10-15 Sanjomachi Aobaku Sendai 981-0935 
 
【Website】 https://sup.bureau.tohoku.ac.jp/en/pre-arrival-e/find-a-place-e/ 
 
 
 
1 Room Availability 
  Room availability is subject to change.  
●University House Aobayama

     Single Room (Female, 11～12㎡)    71 rooms 
 
●University House Sanjo  
A Type (Male, 10㎡)          22 rooms  ※Communal showers and toilets

※A Type rooms are mainly for undergraduate students, B Type rooms are mainly for

2 Eligibility 
International students enrolled at Tohoku University as of October 2026 are eligible 
(undergraduate students, graduate students, research students, non-degree students, special 
auditing students, special research students).  
 
(1) Students planning to enter Tohoku University from this October must apply to the dorm 
rooms now. 
 
(2) Please confirm the following before applying for dormitories. 
  
① There is no guarantee that your first choice will be approved. Please understand that due to 
the number of rooms available and the number of applicants, you will likely be assigned to 
your second choice or lower. Every year, we receive appeals for changes of accommodations 
after housing has been assigned. However, we cannot accept such requests. Please do not 
enter a preference for a dormitory where you do not wish to live. 
 
② Residents cannot smoke in dorms or on the premises. 
 
③ UH Aobayama residents pay 5,200 yen for resident services such as bedding and other 
rental items in addition to the room fee. Please note that residents cannot refuse any of the 
services even if they do not need them. This fee is calculated on a monthly basis covering the 
period from the 16th of each month to the 15th of the following month. 
 
④ International House Sanjo 1 is an old dormitory, and the condition of the rooms is not good. 
There may be cosmetic damage to the walls, furniture, etc. Please be aware of this when 
applying for it. 
 
3 Duration of Stay 
In general, one of the periods below. Please refer to "7 Move-in Date " for the move-in start 
date.

3 
 
 
(1) October 1, 2024 - February 28, 2026 
(2) October 1, 2024 - August 31, 2026 
 
※1  Due to room cleaning for the next semester, students cannot stay in the dorms until 
September 30(for the Spring Semester) or March 31 (for the Fall Semester). 
 
※2  If students leave the dorm by the 15th day of the final month of the approved period of 
stay, rent and management charges for the relevant month will be half of the regular fee. 
However, students whose duration of stay is scheduled to end on September 15 are not 
eligible to receive this discount for August even if they leave before August 15. This 
discount applies only to the final month written on the Residence Permit.  
 
4 Rent and facilities 
 Please see ‘dorm list 2026.10’  
 
5 How to apply 
Please submit your application through the online Google form, the Dormitory Application 
Form. 
 
Application Deadline： July 16 at 11:59 PM (JST) 
 
If students do not submit the application form by the deadline, the university will assign the 
students to a random dormitory. 
 
6 Announcement of Selection Outcome 
Students will be contacted in early-September via the Student Exchange Division. 
 
7 Move-in Date 
Please attend the registration meeting at your dorm on the day you arrive. After the meeting, 
you will receive your room key. Students can start moving into their dorms on the date below.  
 
Move-in Start Date： September 25, 2026 (Fri.) 
 
Note: Students cannot move in on Saturdays and Sundays.  
 
8 Residence Permit Cancellation & Eviction 
Those who fail to move in within seven days of the start of the move-in period without 
providing a reason, allow unauthorized persons to stay overnight in their rooms, violate 
University House Management Regulations or International House Regulations, or disobey 
instructions issued by the university or the dormitory office, may lose their Residence Permit 
or be evicted.

4 
 
 
9 Notes 
Students who wish to apply for a couple's or family room should contact the Student 
Exchange Division for further information.
